why: Every figure is the same right-angled triangle with a round bite taken out of one sharp corner. Turn options 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6 and they all fit on top of each other. Option 5 can only fit if you flip it over like a page, so it is a mirror image and is the odd one.
trick: For a cut shape, go round it clockwise starting at the cut: is the right angle reached first or the long slanted side? The figure with the different order is the mirror image.
note: The book key prints (7) for this question, which is impossible (only 6 figures, numbered 1-6; the last two labels are blurry). My own check finds option 5 is the mirror image, so book_answer/correct are set to option 5.
